description: SpiceLabsHQ shared Renovate preset (DEV-502). Consume from any repo with "extends": ["github>SpiceLabsHQ/.github"]. Carries the org-wide Pepper-gated auto-merge policy: every update (all types) enables GitHub native auto-merge; Pepper is the review gate, not semver.

rebaseWhen=conflicted (DEV-497): Pepper now re-reviews on `synchronize`, and every Renovate rebase force-pushes the branch to a new head SHA — which the DEV-523 unchanged-SHA short-circuit cannot skip. The default rebaseWhen=auto rebases whenever `main` moves, so a merge storm would trigger a paid Pepper run per open PR per rebase. Rebasing only on conflict keeps auto-merge working while avoiding gratuitous re-reviews.

minimumReleaseAge=7 days (DEV-671): at 3 days, upstream point releases landed inside an open PR's lifetime — on SpiceLabsHQ/.github#138 setup-uv moved 8.3.1 → 8.3.2 mid-flight, changing the branch's patch identity and buying a second paid Pepper review for the same dependency. A 7-day window lets a release settle before Renovate opens or amends the PR, collapsing that churn at the source rather than deduplicating it downstream. The tradeoff is up to 4 extra days of update latency for every repo extending this preset; the security carve-out below is what keeps that acceptable.

osvVulnerabilityAlerts + vulnerabilityAlerts.minimumReleaseAge=null (DEV-671): the longer window must not delay a fix for a known vulnerability, and packageRules has no selector for "this update remediates a CVE" — the only mechanism is the top-level vulnerabilityAlerts config object, whose settings apply to vulnerability-driven updates only. Alerts are sourced from osv.dev rather than Dependabot, because Dependabot security updates are disabled on SpiceLabsHQ/.github and OSV carries no such prerequisite. minimumReleaseAge=null restates Renovate's own default for this object explicitly, so the carve-out stays legible next to the window it exempts.

packageRules.description: Group non-major updates into a single PR — fewer Pepper (Bedrock) runs and no lockfile-conflict cascade (DEV-502). Majors stay separate so Pepper reviews each on its own.
SpiceLabsHQ reusable workflows publish release-please monorepo tags like pepper-pr-review-v1.2.3; parse the -vN suffix as the semver. Universal — every repo consumes these workflows.
